mapper.sql: id, module_key, position_key, label, description, component, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ai_position
AND status = #{status}
AND (label LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR module_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR position_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_position (module_key, position_key, label, description, component, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{moduleKey}, #{positionKey}, #{label}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{component, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sortOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT module_key AS moduleKey, label AS label FROM ai_position WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY module_key, label ORDER BY MIN(sort_order) ASC
